description: Verify that DUT TCP uses RTO = 1 sec initially (RFC 6298 §2.1)
approach:
[Objective]
RFC 6298 §2.1 sets the spec-default initial RTO at 1 s — used until the first RTT sample arrives.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT active OPEN → DUT → Tester: SYN.
2. Tester drops the SYN.
3. Observation: DUT SYN retx after ~1 s.

[Pass condition]
SYN retx interval within RFC 6298 initial window centred on 1 s.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_first_syn — initial SYN missing
• Fail_no_syn_retx — no SYN retx
• Fail_rto_out_of_window — RTO out of bounds

verdicts.Fail_no_syn_retx: No DUT SYN retransmit within listen window
verdicts.Fail_rto_out_of_window: SYN retransmit RTO out of RFC 6298 window
